bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; establishing a moratorium on the formation of new charter schools; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124E.06, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124E.06, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 8.

Two-year moratorium.

Beginning July 1, 2025, through July 1, 2027, the commissioner is prohibited from approving an authorizer's affidavit to charter a school or a supplemental affidavit to add grades or sites to an existing charter school. An authorizer whose affidavit was approved prior to July 1, 2025, may continue planning activities and open the approved school or add grades or sites as planned.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: Beginning July 1, 2025, through July 1, 2027, the commissioner is prohibited from approving an authorizer's affidavit to charter a school or a supplemental affidavit to add grades or sites to an existing charter school. This section is effective the day following final enactment.
